Carlos Albornoz's pets and animals: puppy Max (reported 2023-05-23); horses for whom he was running low on hay (2023-05-27); goats Billy and Whiskers, whose trough he replaced with a filtered one; Billy can be mischievous and aggressive around food, and Whiskers is female with long whiskers (2023-05-27); and pig Porky, whose pen fencing he wanted to make safer (2023-05-27).

Carlos Albornoz's travel experiences and interests: took a solo trip to Japan in 2022; drove from San Francisco to Chicago, stopping overnight in Denver, enjoying Colorado's Rocky Mountains and meeting friends in Denver (date not specified); took a week-long Hawaii vacation with his parents and younger sibling (reported 2023-05-27); considered a solo trip to Asia, especially Vietnam, for its cuisine and a possible Hanoi cooking class and market visit (2023-05-27); and planned a Chicago-to-Rocky-Mountains road trip with interest in Mount Rushmore and Badlands National Park (2023-05-26).

Carlos Albornoz's abstract artwork Turmoil developed as an experimental project: on 2023-05-23 he explored layering, texture, brushstrokes, color, uncertainty, chaos, and beauty in chaos, and said making it felt liberating; he drew inspiration from Claude Monet, Anna Mason, and Beatrix Ost and considered modeling paste, gel medium, and drybrushing; he also wanted advice on photographing its texture and dimension for an online portfolio. Latest recorded state (2023-05-23): experimenting and considering materials and documentation, with no completion reported.

Carlos Albornoz's community-garden plan: on 2023-05-24 he said he had always wanted to start a neighborhood community garden and was excited to plan it and recruit volunteers; he intended to start with tomatoes, cucumbers, and strawberries and asked about equipment and pest protection. Advice covered crop rotation, barriers, inspections, companion planting and beneficial insects. Latest recorded state (2023-05-24): planning and considering pest-prevention approaches; no garden launch was reported.

Carlos Albornoz's social-media promotion plans: on 2023-05-23 he said he had created a content calendar for his cousin's art exhibition and realized he had promoted others more than himself; he planned a calendar for his own blog and freelance writing services, with engagement metrics, while balancing consistency against overposting or sacrificing quality. He had little experience with Instagram and Twitter, and was considering LinkedIn book reviews and quotes, including a possible Nightingale review connected to marketing storytelling; he also considered behind-the-scenes reading-nook or bookmark content. Latest recorded state (2023-05-23): planning self-promotion content; no completed calendar for his own work was confirmed.

Carlos Albornoz's prospective gaming YouTube channel: on 2023-05-26 he was considering uploading walkthroughs and reviews, had set up a YouTube account, and was watching tutorials on editing and recording gameplay; after getting and enjoying Horizon Zero Dawn, he considered recording it but had not chosen between it and Cyberpunk 2077 or Assassin's Creed Valhalla. Latest recorded state (2023-05-26): preparing and weighing a first game, with no published videos or final choice reported.

Carlos Albornoz's sleep-routine concern: on 2023-05-25 he went to bed at 11:45 PM after losing track of time while watching a series, despite having herbal tea at 10:30 PM; on 2023-05-26 he said he was struggling to wake and feel rested, and thought a consistent bedtime routine and avoiding screens might help. He asked about wind-down activities; reading and breathing exercises were suggested, but he did not report adopting them. Latest recorded state (2023-05-26): seeking ideas, with no routine change confirmed.

Carlos Albornoz's Chicago-to-Rocky-Mountains road-trip planning: on 2023-05-26 he was interested in Mount Rushmore, Badlands National Park, and possibly a higher hike in Rocky Mountain National Park if weather allowed; he planned a mix of hotels and lodges, had booked some accommodations while preserving flexibility, and already had hiking boots, outdoor clothing, and a packing plan including water, snacks, sunscreen, a first-aid kit, and camera. He was considering a portable charger and said he would look into options. Latest recorded state (2023-05-26): trip planned, with no dates or charger purchase reported.

Carlos Albornoz's possible solo Vietnam trip: on 2023-05-27 he expressed interest in visiting Vietnam for local cuisine, considered a cooking class in Hanoi that would provide recipes and notes, and wanted to visit a local market beforehand to learn about ingredients. Latest recorded state (2023-05-27): exploring ideas; no booking or final travel decision was reported.

Carlos Albornoz's eco-friendly sculpture exploration: on 2023-05-27 he considered entering a local sculpture competition and said he had acquired a modeling tool set, wire cutter, and sculpting mat; he explored using plastic bottles and cardboard tubes as a base and leaves, twigs, and seeds for texture, including ways to prepare, shape, and connect them without adhesives. Latest recorded state (2023-05-27): considering recycled and natural materials and techniques; no finished sculpture or competition entry was reported.
